x_banknote.lore.common: Gets folded and refolded so many times that the face on it looks like it's winking.

x_planner.lore.rare: Squeezes an extra hour into every Saturday, and the clocks are still trying to work out where it came from.

x_sticky_note.lore.rare: Multiplies overnight, so one reminder on the fridge becomes forty by breakfast.

x_comic.lore.rare: Makes its reader shout KAPOW out loud on the quiet train without noticing.

x_easel.lore.common: Collapses its legs every time someone bumps the table, with the wet painting still on it.

x_flag.lore.uncommon: Is waved so hard at the match that its stick snaps in half by the second goal.

x_picture_frame.lore.epic: Fell off its hook during the party, and a domino line of frames went down the whole hallway.

x_pin_cushion.lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a little tomato, and guests keep trying to put it in the salad.

x_wall_art.lore.common: Gets moved to a new wall every spring clean, and never looks right anywhere.

x_sewing_needle.lore.rare: Vanishes into the sofa cushions and reappears in someone's sock a week later.

x_thumbtack.lore.rare: Hops out of its tin whenever the lid is opened, scattering across the carpet.
